description: Maps customer-facing workflow stages, trust-sensitive moments, automation-safe areas, human-critical areas, missing information, and confidence.

aiIdea.description: AI or automation idea that may affect customer touchpoints.

currentProblem.description: Main customer journey or workflow problem the user wants to solve.

currentWorkflow.description: Current workflow steps, tools, owners, and handoffs.

customerJourney.description: Known customer journey stages from first contact through retention.

deliveryProcess.description: How the business delivers the offer or service after onboarding.

onboardingProcess.description: How new customers are welcomed, scoped, educated, or set up.

recoveryProcess.description: How complaints, refunds, exceptions, or service recovery are handled.

retentionProcess.description: How renewals, repeat purchases, referrals, or ongoing customer value are managed.

riskConcerns.description: Concerns about trust, customer experience, brand reputation, privacy, or quality control.

salesProcess.description: How leads are qualified, sold, and converted before delivery begins.

supportProcess.description: How customer questions, issues, tickets, or requests are handled.

touchpoints.description: Specific customer-facing moments, handoffs, or interactions to review.

name: map_customer_touchpoints

automationSafeAreas.description: Areas that appear suitable for AI assistance or automation with low risk.

confidence.description: Confidence level based on the clarity and completeness of the provided business context.

humanCriticalAreas.description: Areas where human review or ownership should remain explicit.

missingInformation.description: Information the user should provide to improve diagnostic confidence.

touchpoints.description: Reviewed customer touchpoints with classification, reason, and suggested control.

classification.description: Whether this touchpoint appears safe for automation, needs hybrid review, or should remain human-critical.

description.description: Short explanation of what happens at this touchpoint.

stage.description: Customer journey stage or workflow touchpoint.

suggestedControl.description: Suggested review, escalation, or quality-control rule for this touchpoint.

trustSensitiveMoments.description: Moments where customer trust, expectations, or brand perception may be at risk.

title: Map Customer Touchpoints
